Get the ULTIMATE Deluxe Edition and Become the Coolest Crazy Cat Lady With the Coolest Cats!

Get the ultimate Cat Chess pack, show your support get cool skins and customization options for your cats and games. Everything included in the "supporter kitty" and more!

This is the best kitty bag for the best kitty owners! Which includes:

  • A new, exclusive FULL CATS SET of pirate cats!!

  • 1 New pirate cat station

  • 1 New chess board

  • A special dark electronic music pack

This will be also shown to other players so you can show off your special cats to friends you play against! 

Note: getting this DLC is also GREAT way to support the developer and we appreciate it a lot!
